title: Launching your app from a Live Activity

segments.source: Launching your app from a Live Activity
segments.ko: 라이브 액티비티에서 앱 실행하기

segments.source: **Framework**: ActivityKit
segments.ko: **프레임워크**: ActivityKit

segments.source: Use deep links to enable people to open your app’s scene that matches the data of you Live Activity.
segments.ko: 딥 링크를 사용하여 사용자가 Live Activity 데이터와 일치하는 앱의 씬을 열 수 있게 합니다.

segments.source: Overview
segments.ko: Overview

segments.source: People can tap a Live Activity to launch your app.
segments.ko: 사용자는 Live Activity를 탭하여 앱을 실행할 수 있습니다.

segments.source: To let them view more content or make changes to an ongoing task, open your app to the scene that matches the content of the Live Activity.
segments.ko: 사용자가 더 많은 콘텐츠를 보거나 진행 중인 작업을 변경할 수 있도록, Live Activity의 콘텐츠와 일치하는 씬으로 앱을 엽니다.

segments.source: Respond to the Systems Default Launch Behavior
segments.ko: 시스템 기본 런치 동작에 응답하기

segments.source: If you don’t explicitly provide a deep link into your app, the system opens your app and passes an [`NSUserActivity`](https://developer.apple.com/documentation/Foundation/NSUserActivity) to [`onContinueUserActivity(_:perform:)`](https://developer.apple.com/documentation/SwiftUI/View/onContinueUserActivity(_:perform:)), [`application(_:continue:restorationHandler:)`](https://developer.apple.com/documentation/UIKit/UIApplicationDelegate/application(_:continue:restorationHandler:)), or [`application(_:continue:restorationHandler:)`](https://developer.apple.com/documentation/AppKit/NSApplicationDelegate/application(_:continue:restorationHandler:)).
segments.ko: 앱에 대해 딥 링크를 명시적으로 제공하지 않으면, 시스템이 앱을 열고 [`NSUserActivity`](https://developer.apple.com/documentation/Foundation/NSUserActivity)를 [`onContinueUserActivity(_:perform:)`](https://developer.apple.com/documentation/SwiftUI/View/onContinueUserActivity(_:perform:)), [`application(_:continue:restorationHandler:)`](https://developer.apple.com/documentation/UIKit/UIApplicationDelegate/application(_:continue:restorationHandler:)), [`application(_:continue:restorationHandler:)`](https://developer.apple.com/documentation/AppKit/NSApplicationDelegate/application(_:continue:restorationHandler:))에 전달합니다.

segments.source: Implement the appropriate callback and check whether the `NSUserActivity` object’s [`activityType`](https://developer.apple.com/documentation/Foundation/NSUserActivity/activityType) is [`NSUserActivityTypeLiveActivity`](https://developer.apple.com/documentation/WidgetKit/NSUserActivityTypeLiveActivity).
segments.ko: 적절한 콜백을 구현하고 `NSUserActivity` 객체의 [`activityType`](https://developer.apple.com/documentation/Foundation/NSUserActivity/activityType)가 [`NSUserActivityTypeLiveActivity`](https://developer.apple.com/documentation/WidgetKit/NSUserActivityTypeLiveActivity)인지 확인합니다.

segments.source: Then, add code to open a screen in your app that fits the context of the active Live Activity.
segments.ko: 그다음, 활성 Live Activity의 컨텍스트에 맞는 화면을 앱에서 열도록 코드를 추가합니다.

segments.source: ❗ **Important**: In CarPlay, tapping your Live Activity only launches your app if it supports CarPlay.
segments.ko: ❗ **중요**: CarPlay에서 Live Activity를 탭하면 앱이 CarPlay를 지원하는 경우에만 앱이 실행됩니다.

segments.source: For more information about adding CarPlay support to your app, refer to [`CarPlay`](https://developer.apple.com/documentation/CarPlay).
segments.ko: 앱에 CarPlay 지원을 추가하는 방법에 대한 자세한 내용은 [`CarPlay`](https://developer.apple.com/documentation/CarPlay)를 참조합니다.

segments.source: Add Deep Links to Your App
segments.ko: 앱에 딥 링크 추가

segments.source: With deep links, you specify an URL that directly launches a specific scene in your app, and choose different scenes for each Live Activity presentation:
segments.ko: 딥 링크를 사용하면 앱의 특정 화면을 직접 실행하는 URL을 지정하고, Live Activity 표시마다 다른 화면을 선택할 수 있습니다.

segments.source: To create a deep link into your app from the Lock Screen, compact leading, compact trailing, and minimal presentations, use [`widgetURL(_:)`](https://developer.apple.com/documentation/WidgetKit/DynamicIsland/widgetURL(_:)). When the compact leading and trailing presentations are visible, make sure both link to the same screen in your app.
segments.ko: 잠금 화면, compact leading, compact trailing, minimal 표시에서 앱으로 딥 링크를 생성하려면 [`widgetURL(_:)`](https://developer.apple.com/documentation/WidgetKit/DynamicIsland/widgetURL(_:))를 사용합니다. compact leading 및 compact trailing 표시가 표시되는 경우 두 링크는 모두 앱의 동일한 화면으로 연결되어야 합니다.

segments.source: To create a deep link into your app from the extended presentation, use `widgetURL(_:)`  or SwiftUI’s [`Link`](https://developer.apple.com/documentation/SwiftUI/Link).
segments.ko: 확장된(extended) 표시에서 앱으로 딥 링크를 생성하려면 `widgetURL(_:)` 또는 SwiftUI의 [`Link`](https://developer.apple.com/documentation/SwiftUI/Link)를 사용합니다.

segments.source: Configure How Your Live Activity Launches Your App in Watchos
segments.ko: watchOS에서 Live Activity를 통한 앱 실행 구성

segments.source: Live Activities automatically appear in the Smart Stack on Apple Watch, and the system shows the Live Activity more prominently on Apple Watch when it receives updates with an alert.
segments.ko: Live Activity는 Apple Watch의 Smart Stack에 자동으로 표시되며, 시스템은 알림이 포함된 업데이트를 수신하면 Apple Watch에서 해당 Live Activity를 더 눈에 띄게 표시합니다.

segments.source: When a Live Activity receives an update:
segments.ko: Live Activity에 업데이트가 수신되면:

segments.source: If a person doesn’t actively use an app on Apple Watch, the system displays an alert that uses the compact presentation’s leading and trailing views, and then launches the Smart Stack, displaying the Live Activity at the top of the stack.
segments.ko: 사용자가 Apple Watch에서 앱을 적극적으로 사용하지 않는 경우, 시스템은 compact presentation의 leading 및 trailing 보기를 사용하는 알림을 표시한 뒤 Smart Stack을 실행하고 스택 맨 위에 Live Activity를 표시합니다.

segments.source: If a person actively uses any app on Apple Watch, the system shows an alert to let them know about the updated Live Activity.
segments.ko: 사용자가 Apple Watch에서 어떤 앱이든 적극적으로 사용 중인 경우, 시스템은 업데이트된 Live Activity를 알리기 위해 알림을 표시합니다.

segments.source: Tapping the alert displays the Live Activity on Apple Watch and the option to launch the app on iPhone.
segments.ko: 알림을 탭하면 Apple Watch에서 Live Activity가 표시되고 iPhone에서 앱을 실행할 수 있는 옵션이 제공됩니다.

segments.source: You can opt-in to give people the ability to open your Watch app from your Live Activity.
segments.ko: Live Activity에서 Watch 앱을 열 수 있도록 사용자가 선택하도록 설정할 수 있습니다.

segments.source: In the Build Settings for your watchOS app target, add the `Supports Launch for Live Activity Attribute Types` key in the `Info.plist` section.
segments.ko: watchOS 앱 대상의 Build Settings에서 `Info.plist` 섹션에 `Supports Launch for Live Activity Attribute Types` 키를 추가합니다.

segments.source: To launch your Watch app for all your Live Activities, leave its value empty.
segments.ko: 모든 Live Activity에 대해 Watch 앱을 실행하려면 해당 값을 비워 둡니다.

segments.source: To launch for specific Live Activities, add an item for each [`ActivityAttributes`](activityattributes.md) conforming type that launches your watchOS app.
segments.ko: 특정 Live Activity를 실행하려면 watchOS 앱을 실행하는 각 [`ActivityAttributes`](activityattributes.md) 준수 형식에 대한 항목을 추가합니다.
